title: NPU model bundle (Nemotron EN, QNN) and user-selectable speech engine setting
description: Add the Qualcomm NPU English model to the catalog and an `asrEngine` setting ("npu" default, or "cpu" for Kroko) so the user chooses the engine; the app downloads the models for the chosen engine (goal 1).
steps: In `ModelCatalog` add `ASR_EN_NPU`: id `asr-en-nemotron-0.6b-560ms-qnn`, displayName "English speech recognition (NPU)", kind ASR, language "en", archive = ModelArchive(url = `https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/download/asr-models-qnn-2/sherpa-onnx-qnn-nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b-560s-android-aarch64.tar.bz2`, sizeBytes = 421938876, rootDir = `sherpa-onnx-qnn-nemotron-speech-streaming-en-0.6b-560s-android-aarch64`), files (url ""): `libencoder.so` 591964328, `libdecoder.so` 14888744, `libjoiner.so` 2107784, `tokens.txt` 8952, `test_wavs/0.wav` 212044; asr = AsrFiles("libencoder.so", "libdecoder.so", "libjoiner.so", "tokens.txt", modelType = "nemo_transducer"). Add it to `all`.

Replace `asrFor(language)` with `asrFor(language: String, engine: String)` and add `fun effectiveEngine(language: String, engine: String): String = if (language == "en" && engine == "npu") "npu" else "cpu"`. `asrFor`: effective "npu" → ASR_EN_NPU; "cpu" → ASR_EN / ASR_FR by language (unknown language throws). Replace `requiredFor(language)` with `requiredFor(language: String, engine: String) = listOf(asrFor(language, engine), SEGMENTATION, EMBEDDING)`.
Add `val asrEngine: String = "npu"` to `AppSettings`; `SettingsRepository.update` keeps the old value unless it is "npu" or "cpu".

Update every caller to pass `settings.asrEngine`: `MainActivity` start destination, the home FAB check, the `ModelSetupViewModel` factory, and `SherpaTranscriberFactory` (which must now pick the bundle with `asrFor(language, engine)`; the NPU bundle is wired to a real backend in the next task — until then throw `IllegalStateException("NPU engine not available yet")` when the effective engine is npu).
Update `ModelCatalogTest`, `SettingsRepositoryTest` and `ModelSetupViewModelTest` for the new signatures.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `requiredFor("en", "npu")` ids = [asr-en-nemotron-0.6b-560ms-qnn, seg-pyannote-3-0-int8, emb-wespeaker-resnet34-lm]; `requiredFor("en", "cpu")` starts with `asr-en-kroko-2025-08-06`; `requiredFor("fr", "npu")` starts with `asr-fr-kroko-2025-08-06`
Test: default `asrEngine` is "npu"; updating it to "gpu" keeps the previous value; "cpu" round-trips
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
